desc:
Buy items from other players’ outfits to earn Coins! When someone buys an item from your outfit, you earn Coins too. Use your Coins to get avatar items you can wear in every Roblox game!

How to Play:
• Create an outfit and put it on your booth! 🎨
• Shop outfits made by other players! 🛍️
• Earn Coins when you buy avatar items! 🪙
• Earn Coins when someone buys an item from your outfit! 💰
• Spend your Coins on avatar items you can wear in every Roblox game! 🎁

✅ All in-game avatar item purchases will be added in your Roblox inventory & can be worn in all games!
